notes.title: Trading Cards & Linux version
notes.notes:
Hello! Firstly, thank you all so much for the amazing support we've received for Charnel House Trilogy so far. Hope you're all enjoying the game! 

Two things: Trading cards ARE coming, we just want to make sure the assets are as good as they can possibly be. We're doing something a little fun and different with the art, so hopefully it'll be worth the wait! ETA is within a week, so you shouldn't have to wait long.

Secondly, we have a Linux build of the game, which will be going up by Monday. AGS Linux builds aren't guaranteed flawless, so we need a little more time to put that build through some extra testing, and make sure it's functioning well enough before we push it live.

I'm sure a lot of you know this already but Mac builds are a bit harder to do with AGS; it IS something we want to do in the future if the game does well enough to enable us to do so, but unfortunately not something we were able to do for launch. The intention is to do so, but I can't make any die-hard promises just yet. If we are able to do a Mac version then we'll likely be able to create a Mac version of Richard & Alice at the same time too. 

Thanks!
Nina <3
